The '''Jiroch system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the system included [[Jiroch-Reslia]], [[Jiroch-Kalok]], and [[Jiroch-Saloch]]. Rumors of a Jedi artifact hidden somewhere in the system circulated throughout known space; however, the [[Tunroth]] natives of Jiroch-Reslia denied it.
